subject: general
question: Which agreement is linked to the Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 1985?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Assam Accord**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Assam Accord** was signed on **15 August 1985** between the Government of India and leaders of the Assam Movement.
 
• The accord aimed to address the issue of **illegal immigration** into Assam, particularly from neighboring countries like Bangladesh.
 
• The Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 1985 was introduced as a result of the Assam Accord, amending the Citizenship Act, 1955.
 
• The Assam Accord defined specific cut-off dates for identifying and deporting **illegal immigrants**. People who entered Assam after **March 24, 1971** were to be identified and deported.
 
• The accord also provided for the protection of **Assamese cultural identity**, language, and heritage while addressing the concerns of indigenous communities.
 
• It led to the establishment of mechanisms to detect and deport foreigners, including the formation of **Foreigners' Tribunals**.
 
• The Assam Accord continues to be a cornerstone in debates surrounding **citizenship and immigration policies** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Shimla Agreement**__

 __
 
• The **Shimla Agreement** was signed on **2 July 1972** between **India and Pakistan** following the Indo-Pak war of 1971.
 
• It aimed at restoring peace and normalizing relations between the two nations.
 
• The agreement established the **Line of Control (LoC)** in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• It holds significance in the context of India's foreign policy and relations with Pakistan but is unrelated to the issue of citizenship or immigration.
 
 
 
• **Indo-Sri Lanka Pact**__
 __
 
• The **Indo-Sri Lanka Pact**, also known as the **Rajiv Gandhi-Jayewardene Accord**, was signed in **1987**.
 
• It aimed at resolving the **Sri Lankan Civil War** and ensuring the rights of Tamil minorities in Sri Lanka.
 
• The pact led to the deployment of the **Indian Peace Keeping Force (IPKF)** in Sri Lanka.
 
• While significant in the context of international relations, it is not connected to the citizenship issues addressed by the Assam Accord.
 
 
 
• **Kashmir Agreement**__
 
 
• The term **Kashmir Agreement** often refers to attempts or discussions to resolve the issue of **Jammu and Kashmir** between India and Pakistan.
 
• It pertains to territorial disputes and regional autonomy rather than citizenship or immigration-related concerns.
 
• It holds importance in the geopolitical context but is unrelated to the Assam Accord or the Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 1985.
